title: Amendment 2 spec review 4: move the record to interphase 0.8.1, fix three issues, dispatch review 5 as the last
context: Spec review 4 of amendment 2 (docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.md) reported 3 issues: f-note10-trials explained the 24.4 fps oneflight replay as a scene built before the replay window, contradicted by the run's end state (two Meadow stages, one unsharp after 82 build steps) and its command did not print its output; 10.15 had no limit on sessions or waiting and no order between verdicts; the throttle-share verdict had no margin and its defaults were not listed as assumptions. Interphase updated itself from 0.8.0 to 0.8.1 at 17:04 mid-run (this session holds 0.8.1); 0.8.1 drops the record's reviews list, the domain fields source/closed/defined_by/invalid, criteria keeps, step reads, assumed facts and the no-progress stop, and its check_record refused the 0.8.0-format record with 60+ unknown-key errors. Six more alternating onboarding replays on the Note10+ (r5) ran within 0.8 fps of the unchanged build, each ending with one Meadow stage; P-of-fix-fresh-onboard-2 is the only one of 26 replays that ends with two stages.
options: Follow installed interphase 0.8.1: strip the dropped fields, keep the 0.8.0 review history at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/review/spec-reviews-amend-2.json, move the two assumed facts to section 11 assumptions (already stated there), fix all three review 4 issues and dispatch review 5 as the last
Keep running the orphaned 0.8.0 scripts and format to the end of the amendment
Treat review 4 (3 issues after 2) as a no-progress stop and stop again without hand-off
option_reasons: The installed version governs the session (its .in_use lists this session) and the hook briefing names 0.8.1's phases.md; 0.8.1's check passes after the migration with no content lost, and the owner's go-ahead plus the five-review convergence rule bound the reviews
0.8.0 is marked orphaned and will be removed; mixing an uninstalled checker with the installed reviewer and phases risks a hand-off no installed tool accepts
0.8.1 has no no-progress stop, the owner already said to continue past the review 3 stop, and the convergence rule names review 5 as the last
outcome: Follow 0.8.1. Record migrated (check_record --complete passes); f-note10-trials rewritten with a literal command and output (two stages, throttle after unknown, cause unknown); new fact f-note10-r5 (31.6, 31.4, 30.9 fps against 32.1, 31.9, 32.3, level 2 before and 0 after each); 10.15 now rests the phone up to ten minutes, gives three attempts a run, and orders verdicts (unchanged build short: no verdict, a second session, then unproven; change short: fail; change's uncounted attempts three or more above the unchanged build's: fail; else the bounds); section 11 lists those defaults; decisions line 11 corrected. Every render and check passes; review copies deleted (0.8.1 has none). Review 5 dispatched as the last; after it only build-affecting or mechanical findings get fixed.
